name: Remove Background
description: Step-by-step state machine for removing the background from an image on the Canva canvas workspace.

states.name: Canvas Open
states.description: Canva editor active with image placed on canvas artboard
states.instruction: Click on the image or poster on your canvas to select it.

verification.condition: Purple selection outline (#8B3DFF) or floating context toolbar appears

states.name: Image Selected
states.description: Image is surrounded by selection border, top contextual toolbar is visible
states.instruction: In the top Canva toolbar, click 'Edit photo' (or 'Edit').

verification.condition: Left sidebar opens showing Magic Studio / Effects tools

states.name: Magic Studio Panel Open
states.description: Left sidebar displays tools including BG Remover, Magic Eraser, and Adjust
states.instruction: In the left Edit photo panel, click 'BG Remover'.

verification.condition: Canva performs background removal and modifies canvas pixels

states.name: Background Removed
states.description: Image is now isolated with a transparent background
states.instruction: Review the canvas to verify the background has been removed.

verification.condition: Subject is cleanly isolated on canvas
